scientific_question: Is the complete sparse-MoE failure caused by insufficient rank-480 input-direction capacity, unstable causal acquisition of that input atlas, or the compact pseudo-random coefficient map used to realize expert hyperplanes inside an otherwise sufficient atlas?

evidence_chain: The sealed rank-480 write prerequisite recovers about 0.895 heldout routed output and 0.690 analytic input JVP in both discovery banks, so output-write rank is not the current binding constraint.

The full-width pre-GELU chart preserves all 1536 GELU slots but recovers only about 0.535 output and 0.018 input JVP. Learned rotations improve the fixed-mixing control by only about 0.025 output and 0.007 JVP.

Therefore hidden scalar width is not enough: the activation hyperplanes remain a fixed pseudo-random image of one rank-480 input chart, and their directions fail to follow the dense teacher's functional tangent.

A new learned generator is not yet justified. First grant an oracle dense node-specific coefficient matrix inside a task-functional global rank-480 input atlas, then separately impose the already sealed rank-480 output atlas.
theory.dense_expert: For node n=(layer,expert), f_n(x)=Wproj_n GELU(Wfc_n x) and J_n(x)=Wproj_n diag(GELU'(Wfc_n x)) Wfc_n.
theory.input_metric: Estimate each node's input-Jacobian Gram G_n=E[J_n(x)^T J_n(x)] with four deterministic Rademacher output probes per routed discovery sample. Normalize every G_n by its trace before equal-node aggregation, then take the leading 480 eigenvectors as one global input atlas U.
theory.metric_ceiling: The heldout energy retained by J_n(x) U^T U is the direct tangent-direction capacity of the selected atlas. Discovery-A and discovery-B atlases are causal; a heldout-fitted atlas is an explicitly leaking same-split capacity reference.
theory.realizable_input_oracle: For each node and bank, fit an unrestricted dense coefficient A_n in Wfc_hat_n=A_n U by ridge least squares on routed preactivations. This is the best registered linear preactivation regression inside U for that bank, followed by the exact GELU and untouched dense Wproj. It tests realizability of nonlinear hyperplanes after removing compact-generator error.
theory.paired_oracle: Project the realizable oracle's expert outputs and analytic input JVPs into the matching sealed rank-480 global write basis V. This tests simultaneous input and output atlases without fitting a compact generator.
theory.why_this_is_not_a_candidate: A_n contains 1536x480 dense coefficients for every selected layer/expert and the input-only arm retains dense Wproj. These oracle-only states violate the >=200x deployment budget and cannot authorize language-model training. A pass authorizes design of a compact causal coefficient map; it is not itself a model pass.
theory.paper_reconciliation: The Mapping Networks theorem is local and existential. The paper's PCA/t-SNE motivation does not establish that one pseudo-random global chart is aligned with every expert's GELU boundary geometry. This audit measures the missing local functional atlas condition directly before another modulation or Mapping-Loss experiment.

data_protocol.sampling: Use exact terminal top-2 routing and deterministic 1024-sample expert banks independently in discovery A, discovery B, and heldout. Heldout inputs never affect causal atlases or causal coefficients.

atlas_protocol.node_metric: For routed x and deterministic Rademacher r in output space, compute g=J_n(x)^T r exactly; accumulate four-probe g^T g estimates in float64, divide each node Gram by its own trace, and sum nodes with equal weight.
atlas_protocol.eigensystem: Compute the leading 480 eigenvectors of each split's 768x768 equal-node global Gram in float64. Use discovery A and B independently as causal atlases; use heldout only for the labeled same-split ceiling.
atlas_protocol.cross_bank_overlap: Report mean squared singular cosine between discovery A and B input atlases.
atlas_protocol.metric_ceiling_scoring: On untouched full heldout routed inputs and deterministic analytic-JVP directions, report energy recovery of the dense teacher input Jacobian after right projection by U^T U, using the same four-probe estimator and exact routed mixture aggregation.
atlas_protocol.precision: float32 model actions and probes; float64 Gram accumulation, eigendecomposition, and normal equations

coefficient_protocol.fit_target: Dense node preactivations Wfc_n x on the split's 1024 routed samples per expert.
coefficient_protocol.formula: With Z=X U^T, solve A=(Z^T Z + lambda I)^(-1) Z^T (X Wfc_n^T), then use Wfc_hat_n=A^T U.
coefficient_protocol.ridge: lambda = 1e-4 * trace(Z^T Z) / 480, frozen independently per node and split
coefficient_protocol.causal_arms: Fit A independently from discovery A and discovery B and score both on untouched heldout routed inputs.
coefficient_protocol.same_split_arm: Fit U and A from heldout routed samples and score on heldout. This intentionally leaks the scoring split and is reported only as an optimistic registered acquisition/realization ceiling.
coefficient_protocol.input_only: Use exact dense Wproj after GELU(A_n U x).
coefficient_protocol.paired: Project input-only expert outputs and analytic JVPs into the split-matched sealed global rank-480 write basis before exact top-2 mixture aggregation.
coefficient_protocol.selection: No rank, ridge, probe count, bank, layer, expert, or checkpoint selection from measured recovery.

decision_rule.input_rank_rejected: If even the heldout same-split metric ceiling fails 0.6 Jacobian energy recovery, close one global rank-480 input atlas as tangent-direction insufficient at this allocation. Do not try another rank without a new budget theory.
decision_rule.realization_rejected: If the metric ceiling passes but the heldout same-split dense-coefficient input-only oracle fails an absolute output or JVP gate, close this global-linear input-atlas plus registered ridge realization. Do not blame the compact pseudo-random generator alone.
decision_rule.acquisition_rejected: If heldout same-split input-only and paired arms pass but either causal discovery arm fails, preserve representational sufficiency but require a separately preregistered causal atlas/coefficient acquisition method.
decision_rule.input_pass_write_interaction_fail: If both causal input-only arms pass but either causal paired arm fails despite the sealed write-only prerequisite, localize the failure to joint input/write co-adaptation and require a jointly acquired atlas before any compact generator.
decision_rule.compact_map_localized: Only if both causal paired arms clear every gate may the fixed pseudo-random coefficient map be named the remaining bottleneck. That outcome authorizes theory and preregistration for one compact coefficient-map design at the smallest rung; it does not authorize language-model training automatically.

systems.performance_gate: Run committed-source tests and an exact reduced-shape identity/preflight. Foreground-poll the exact frozen audit only if projected <=5 minutes; otherwise launch one persistent @Codex terminal/error watcher immediately through committed launch_local_detached.py.
systems.callback_policy: Terminal success and actionable failure only for an expected one-to-two-hour audit; add one resettable 90-minute heartbeat only if measured or observed runtime exceeds two hours.
